decision.rule: World time advances only from an accepted logical-time input. Supplied wall elapsed time, presentation time, and native deadline budget are not game-time deltas.
decision.pause: When paused, DueSelectionRequest.target_time must equal the checkpoint LogicalTime. The pure selector returns no processed due events and reports bounded backlog. A future target is InvalidTime.
decision.admission: stage_schedule_advancement requires Some(already-admitted DueSelectionRequest); None returns TimeNotAccepted. The pure functions stage proposals and never mutate or publish the checkpoint.
decision.accepted_unpaused_time: For an admitted unpaused target, due events are ordered by logical tick then canonical RecordId bytes. In this fixture, selected_events=4 admits IDs [1, 2, 3]; the event-1 destination is staged. The checkpoint remains unchanged until the owning session path commits.

items: DueSelectionRequest { expected_basis, target_time, paused, deadline_remaining, policy }
select_due_events validates basis/pins, matching tick units, non-regression and paused equality; paused selection stops event processing and retains backlog.
stage_schedule_advancement requires Some(accepted_time), maps ordered due events to already-admitted destinations and returns an immutable ScheduleAdvancement candidate.
stage_environmental_delta accepts supplied basis/pins and admitted replacements; it is bounded and immutable and does not advance time.
The above functions and their current request/result/error types are public exports; this contract adds no public WorldDelta type.
